privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Asynchrone Space collects, uses and protects your data.
privacy.s1b1: We collect the information you provide when you create an account, including your name, email address and organization details.
privacy.s1b2: We also collect usage data — such as the features you interact with — to operate, secure and improve the service.
privacy.s2b1: We use your information to provide the service, authenticate users, respond to support requests and send product updates you have opted into.
privacy.s2b2: We never sell your personal data.
privacy.s3b1: We retain personal data for as long as your account is active. When you delete an account or organization, we remove or anonymize its data within 30 days, except where we are required to retain it by law. Two records outlive a deleted organization: platform audit events, and the email address and company domain used to claim a Team trial, which we keep to prevent the same trial from being claimed again.
privacy.s4b1: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, export or delete your personal data. Contact privacy@asynchrone.space to exercise these rights.
privacy.s5b1: We use a small set of service providers to run Asynchrone Space. Stripe processes payments, subscriptions and invoices for paid plans; card details are entered on Stripe and never reach our servers. Resend delivers transactional email, and OpenAI powers the AI assistant when it is enabled. Each provider is bound by a data-processing agreement and only receives the data needed for its task. Contact privacy@asynchrone.space for the current list.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The agreement that governs your use of Asynchrone Space.
terms.s1b1: By accessing or using Asynchrone Space, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you use the service on behalf of an organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that organization.
terms.s2b1: You agree not to misuse the service, including by attempting to access it by any means other than the interfaces we provide, or by using it to store or share unlawful content.
terms.s3b1: Paid plans are billed through Stripe Checkout. A subscription renews automatically at the interval and price shown before you pay, until you cancel it; you can cancel or change the payment method at any time from the billing settings, and access continues until the end of the paid period. Taxes are calculated by Stripe from your billing address and shown before you pay. Except where the law requires otherwise, amounts already paid are not refunded.
terms.s4b1: You may stop using the service at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if you violate these terms or if required to protect the service or other users.

security.title: Security
security.description: How Asynchrone Space protects your workspace and data.
security.s1b1: All data is encrypted in transit using TLS and at rest using industry-standard encryption. Credentials are hashed, never stored in plain text.
security.s1b2: We rotate keys regularly and follow least-privilege access for internal systems.
security.s2b1: Organizations include role-based access control with owner, admin, member and viewer roles. File permissions can be set per person and per file.
security.s2b2: SSO, SCIM provisioning and a customer-facing audit log are planned for Enterprise plans.
security.s3b1: We monitor for anomalies. If you believe you have found a vulnerability, contact security@asynchrone.space.
security.s3b2: We disclose incidents promptly and transparently to affected organizations.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: How Asynchrone Space uses cookies and similar technologies.
cookies.s1b1: We use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your preferences such as language and theme, and understand how the product is used so we can improve it.
cookies.s2b1: Essential cookies are required for the service to work. Preference cookies remember settings you choose. Analytics cookies help us measure usage in aggregate.
cookies.s2b2: We do not use cookies to sell your data or to show third-party advertising.
cookies.s3b1: You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may prevent parts of the service from working.
